subject: Charged twice this month??
body: Hi, I just looked at our bank statement and Pharos charged us $80 twice on October 3rd. Same amount, same day. We only have one workspace. Can you please fix this and refund the extra charge? Invoice numbers are PHR-88213 and PHR-88214. Thanks, Maria

subject: where is the cancel button
body: I've looked everywhere in settings and there is no cancel option. The owner asked me to cancel our subscription because we're switching to the project tool that comes with our CRM. How do I do it?

subject: Slack integration broke AGAIN - third time this month
body: This is getting ridiculous. Our Slack channel for the Hartwell client project stopped getting task updates again yesterday, and nobody noticed a blocker for a full day. This is the third time this month I've had to reconnect it. I'm paying for your most expensive plan and I'm seriously looking at other tools now. I need this fixed today.

subject: Nobody is getting email notifications
body: Hello, since about the 15th nobody on our team is getting email notifications when they're assigned a task or mentioned. In-app notifications still show up. We've missed two deadlines this week because people didn't know work was waiting on them. Nothing changed on our end that I know of. Can you look into it?

subject: Questions before I pay
body: Hi! I'm on the trial and loving it so far. Two questions before I pick a plan: can my clients see their own projects without paying for a seat? And can I make some projects private so only two of us can see them?

subject: Locked out - new phone
body: I got a new phone over the weekend and now I can't log in because the 6 digit code app was on my old phone. I never saved any backup codes. I have a client deliverable due tomorrow and all my notes are in Pharos. Please help ASAP.

subject: URGENT Pharos won't load
body: Pharos won't load for anyone on our team. We've been getting a 502 error for the last 30 minutes on laptops and phones. We have a site handoff at 10 and all our checklists are in there. Is Pharos down??

subject: Refund for annual plan
body: Hello, I paid for the annual Team plan 12 days ago, but unfortunately I have to close my studio at the end of the month for family reasons. Is it possible to get a refund for the rest of the year? I'm sorry for the trouble. Grace

subject: Dependencies?
body: Love the app. Any chance you'll add task dependencies to the timeline view? When one task slips I have to move everything after it by hand. Right now I'm tracking it in a spreadsheet lol

subject: Partnership opportunity - 10x your organic traffic
body: Hi there, I came across pharos.example and noticed you're missing out on huge organic traffic. Our team guarantees first-page Google rankings in 30 days. Can I send over a free audit? Reply YES to get started.

subject: Tasks disappeared from our board
body: This morning a whole column of tasks on our Fall Gala board just vanished. There were about 15 tasks in the Vendors column and now it's empty. Nobody on my team says they deleted anything. Where did they go?

subject: Can't add a 4th person
body: Trying to invite a new hire and it says we've reached our member limit. There are only 3 of us at the moment. What are my options?

subject: Former employee requesting deletion of their information
body: A former employee emailed asking us to delete all of their personal information from our systems, including our project management tool. How do we do that in Pharos, and does it remove them from your servers too?

subject: Thank you!
body: Just wanted to say thanks. We switched from sticky notes and a group chat three months ago and we haven't dropped a single client request since. The timeline view alone has saved me hours. Great product!

subject: Client sees due dates a day early
body: I'm in Austin. Our client in London is a guest on our project, and she says every due date shows a day earlier than what I set. A task I set for the 14th shows the 13th for her. Why are the dates different?

subject: password reset not working
body: I clicked forgot password like 5 times and never got an email. Checked spam. My login email might be my old gmail though, not sure.

subject: Why is my bill $135?
body: We have 10 people on the Team plan so I expected $100, but this month's invoice is $135. There's a line that says prorated member charges. I had no idea adding people mid-month cost extra. Can you explain and can I get that taken off?

subject: Need to take over account - previous owner left
body: Our operations manager set up our Pharos workspace and was the owner on it. She left the company last month and isn't responding to us. I'm the company owner and an admin in the workspace. How do I get ownership moved to me so I can manage billing?

subject: Moving to another tool
body: Honestly the integration problems and the surprise charges have been frustrating, so I'm going to switch to a different tool next month. I need to get all our projects, tasks, and files out first. How do I export everything, and then how do I cancel?

subject: Security issue in task comments
body: Hello, I found that task comments don't escape HTML when rendered in the activity feed, so a script posted in a comment runs for anyone who views the feed. This looks like stored XSS. I haven't shared this publicly. Happy to send steps to reproduce privately.
